violations.why: closer2_isr (higher priority) can preempt main between the two reads of test_global_var1 and change it, so they can see different values.
writer2_isr can preempt main between the two reads of test_global_var2 and write it, so the reads can differ.
closer2_isr preempts closer1_isr after its write of 42. It resets tco_expect_close to 0 in i8xx_tco_write, so the check at line 756 can fail.
closer2_isr's i8xx_tco_release sets tco_expect_close to 0 between closer1_isr's write and its read.
closer2_isr can preempt closer1_isr between its write of tco_write_buf and the read in i8xx_tco_write, and overwrite the buffer.
